entity.description: A one-use pairing code an edge node's operator made (System › Edge Clients), good until expireDate (an hour by default). Only its hash is kept (codeHash, as other single-use codes). Pairing sets usedDate and the pairedNodeId it paired; a used or expired code pairs nothing.

A local node paired with this edge node, by its instance id. keyFingerprint is the SHA-256 of the public key of the client certificate it paired with (hex): a link is taken only from that key, while statusId is EdgeClientActive. linkGeneration goes up by one with each new up connection; a connection of an older generation is closed and can no longer answer or acknowledge. The versions and features are the ones its last Hello said.

field.name: setupJson
field.description: What the node's last Configure (the Edge Node wizard's Apply, plans/Edge-Node.md §5.7) set besides its host names: a JSON object of mailDomains, chatBridgeIds and passSites, checked as input from any client.

entity.description: A public host name this edge node answers for a paired local node (plans/Edge-Node.md §5.3), lower case with no port. A name belongs to one node. In EdgeHostPassthrough mode the edge node reads the TLS ClientHello's server name and pipes the connection down the node's link, where the local node ends TLS with its own certificate; while the link is down the connection is refused. In EdgeHostTerminate mode the edge node ends TLS with its own certificate and forwards each request down the link as HTTP/2, adding the client's address; while the link is down it answers with the offline page. The edge node keeps these in memory and loads them again when org.moqui.impl.EdgeServices changes one.

One unit of work queued for the other end of the link: on an edge node the items for a local node (EqdToLocal), on a local node its outbox for the edge node (EqdToEdge). pairedNodeId is the local node of the pair: on an edge node the paired node's id (decision 1), on a local node its own instance id. queueItemId is a UUID, so the receiver's receipt stays unique when this database is lost and made again; sequenceNum orders the items, and the items of one conversationKey (a room, a mailbox, a phone number) are delivered one at a time in that order: a head that failed holds the ones after it until it is delivered or fails for good. idempotencyKey is unique per node and direction: enqueuing it again returns the item there is. kind names the receiver's handler service (the edge queue-kind conf). The payload is text (JSON), or contentLocation names a large body. statusEnumId: EqsPending, EqsDelivered (the receiver applied it, or had already), EqsFailed (the receiver refused it maxAttempts times, or it waited past the retention period or the size cap; kept for inspection the retention period from failedDate). A delivery holds the row (leaseOwner until leaseExpiresDate) while it waits for the answer.

view-entity.description: The head of each conversation key's items: select conversationKey and sequenceNum (the lowest), finding by pairedNodeId, directionEnumId and statusEnumId EqsPending.
The queue's items counted by the fields selected with them (pairedNodeId, directionEnumId, kind, statusEnumId): how many, the oldest queued, and their payloads' bytes.

entity.description: A queue item this node applied, from the other end of the link, by the sender's queueItemId: written in the transaction that applied it, so a redelivery (its acknowledgement was lost) finds it and is only acknowledged. pairedNodeId is the local node of the pair, as on EdgeQueueItem. Kept for the queue's retention period.

On an edge node with the MTA in moqui (edge_mail_mta=moqui, plans/Edge-Node.md §5.4 E5b), the delivery of one message a local node sent (its mailOut queueItemId) to the recipients of one domain, by that domain's MX; the domain "(local node)" is the recipients queued back to the local node itself. Written in the transaction that applies the mailOut item, so the item is delivered once these rows are there. recipientsJson is the addresses still to deliver; mailFrom the envelope sender (the VERP address when edge_mail_bounce_domain is set); contentLocation the signed message, shared by the rows of one message and removed with its last report. statusEnumId: EmdPending (nextAttemptDate is the next try), EmdSent, EmdBounced (bouncedCount refused for good, or not delivered within mail_delivery_days). sentCount and refusedText (each refused address with the answer) are what the report says; reportPending is Y while the report (the mailStatus back) is not queued yet, which each round tries again without delivering again. lastReplyText is the last answer of the MX, or why it was not reached.

On an edge node, the copy of one record of a local node's replicated set (the edge replicate conf): its entity, its primary key and the set's fields of it, as JSON, so the edge node's schema holds none of the business entities. pkHash is the SHA-256 (hex) of the canonical key JSON, by which a value is found; pkJson and fieldsJson are encrypted at rest. replicaEpoch is the local node's snapshot the value was last written under: a full resync writes every value under a new one and then removes those of older ones.

On an edge node, how far a local node's replicated set has been applied: the local node's epoch (each full resync starts one) and the sequence of the last batch applied, written in the transaction that applied it. A batch that does not follow the cursor (this database was lost, or the local node restarted) is answered with a request for a full resync. snapshotDate is when the last full resync finished.

On an edge node, a file of a message its local node sends by address (an MMS picture), put here with the send (the queue kind chatMedia), so the network fetches it from the edge node at /channels/{chatBridgeId}/media/{token} (plans/Edge-Node.md §5.4, E6). edgeMediaId is the SHA-256 (hex) of the token, which the local node makes and only it and the network know; location is the file, under dbresource://moqui/edge/media/. Served until expireDate (channels_media_minutes after it came), then removed with its file.
